reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: No concrete indicator preparation/delivery dose and timing workflow or procedure deriving them before confirmation.

checks.quote: the indicator's own structural signal
checks.reason: The indicator itself is offered as a structural reference without an independent activity-insensitivity/spectral calibration. Co-registration of a static target alone does not establish that independence.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: No unique event-to-spike matching tolerance or residual-decay rule for electrically silent false-event windows; time-normalized false events alone do not settle those labels.

checks.quote: primary independent unit is the *cell
checks.reason: Cell-session/cell independence is asserted for cell-type conclusions. Mentioning animal counts and reporting clustering does not supply an animal-level independent allocation/variance model for precision.

checks.quote: restrict claims to high-SNR cells
checks.reason: Performance-driven restriction is suggested without preserving low-SNR failures and all attempted-cell/time denominators in validation coverage.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: Visual-response curve correlations lack a primary inferential comparison, uncertainty procedure and multiplicity handling.

checks.quote: acellular neuropil
checks.reason: Neuropil contains neuronal processes and can have genuine activity without soma spikes. Its event rate is not a false-positive ground truth. The proposed decay-time Nyquist shortcut also does not establish event bandwidth; charge these core measurement-assumption limitations once here.

checks.quote: 0 to a high fraction
checks.reason: The coefficient/annulus sweep lacks a concrete bounded search and stopping procedure; a high fraction chosen from unspecified ratios is not an executable range-to-lock procedure.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after repairs or validation-driven parameter changes.

checks.quote: spike-locked component survives these regressions
checks.reason: Survival after nuisance regression is demanded without resolving neural signals genuinely correlated with movement/neuropil. Their removal cannot alone falsify neural origin; a ground-truth-conditioned acceptance test is needed.

checks.quote: 50–70% of cell–sessions
checks.reason: The split can place cells/sessions from the same animal in training and test; per-cell silent-label coefficient fitting is also not explicitly restricted to independent calibration blocks. This does not establish the intended out-of-preparation optical validation.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: No stable raw-data/sample/event identifier manifest and exact processing/code/environment versions.

checks.quote: # Proposed Calibration and Validation Protocol for a Genetically Encoded Calcium Indicator (GECI) with Simultaneous Electrophysiology
checks.reason: A structured proposed paired-calibration sequence with silent controls, deliberate known focus offsets, expression strata and failure diagnostics. Important core assumptions remain unresolved: activity-independent reference, neuropil null interpretation, clustered validation and neural-correlated nuisance subtraction. Specific checks own these defects without duplicate general deductions.
